scope: Definition-only candidate bindings of existing SEC004/005 authenticated staff session functions to four logical HTTP routes, minimal projections, claims and finite control work. No public/visitor or operator grant, provider, key, handler, migration or deployment. Routes/encodings/resources require independent review and integrated adoption.
authority: STAFF_SESSION_PROTOCOL and SECURITY_PRIVACY_CONTRACT current principal/session/source freshness and original clocks control. Current or renewal-due token may access its own permitted controls; immediately-prior token may only use protected renewal-recovery within its unchanged window, with current CSRF. Retired-token presentation alone cannot revoke its legitimate current successor. No cookie/ID/CSRF field becomes business/action/object authority.

routes.request: No query or body; exact control header and current eligible staff JWT cookie. No submitted context/principal/session selector.
routes.success: 200 closed own-session snapshot: kind staff_session; context_id equal current server session_ref; authority_revision positive monotonic session-control revision; state current or renewal_required; server_time_ms idle_deadline_ms absolute_deadline_ms renewal_due_ms token_expires_ms. No token/CSRF/principal/name/email/role/grant/work count. No Set-Cookie or activity.
routes.meaning: One coherent current guarded snapshot. authority_revision advances for relevant session-state changes, not reads. context_id is identifying non-bearer metadata for transient UI response fencing, never an input grant. All deadlines/times are exact UTC Unix-millisecond integers in0..253402300799999; raw integer spellings only. Actual deadline ordering/eligibility and state versus renewal_due are semantic checks.
routes.refusal: 403 request_denied/check_access for unknown, invalid, expired, prior-only, revoked, replaced, disabled or undisclosable session/token;503 for unknown required source/store/clock/resource authority. No false signed-out success or redirects.

routes.request: Same safe-read admission as IF-AUTH-01, including exact control header; no CSRF header required to bootstrap this one current-session proof read. No query/body. Prior token cannot bootstrap it.
routes.success: 200 closed {kind:staff_csrf,context_id,csrf_generation,csrf_token}; own current session_ref and positive current CSRF generation; token reuses the already-proposed canonical43-character unpadded base64url of32 random bytes. Intentional transient JS-readable synchronizer proof, never a JWT or bearer substitute. No Set-Cookie, generation rotation, idle activity or grant.
routes.meaning: Reload/new current-token tab can obtain the same still-current session proof. Unknown secret or current generation is unavailable, never a zero/default/recreated proof under GET. A prior-token tab without current in-memory CSRF needs fresh sign-in, not this bootstrap. Guard current context/CSRF before output; client drops a different context/generation late reply.
routes.refusal: Same403/503 policy as own-session status, with no private reason or token echo.

routes.request: No query; closed empty JSON object {}; exact control header, current/prior-recovery eligible staff JWT cookie, current canonical X-HSD-CSRF and existing exact-origin mutation guards. No desired generation, actor, time, expiry or signed token accepted in body.
routes.success: 204 with zero body and one exact host-prefixed staff Set-Cookie carrying current existing/new JWT. Normal issuance/re-delivery is a browser-session cookie: Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/; no Domain/Partitioned/Max-Age/Expires. Current before due re-delivers same claims/identity/times; current at due creates exactly one successor; immediate prior inside original recovery re-delivers that existing current successor only. Acknowledgement is no proof browser stored cookie.
routes.meaning: No original idle/absolute/activity or prior recovery window reset; same CSRF generation. No business effect or uncertain command replay. Prior recovery needs its current CSRF; no expired-JWT recovery. Recheck context/security/token record and output eligibility before Set-Cookie; signing/serialization failure or unknown committed cutover requires current/prior reconciliation, not another generation.
routes.refusal: 403 fixed request_denied/check_access for invalid/unavailable eligibility, source or proof;409 fixed session_changed/check_session when a previously admitted current context/token transition no longer permits the prepared control output;503 service_unavailable/check_session for unknown authoritative result. No stale cookie on refusal.

routes.request: No query; closed empty JSON {}; exact control header and existing exact-origin mutation guards. Eligible current-session logout also requires current X-HSD-CSRF and current token (including renewal-due current); a prior token is not current logout authority.
routes.success: 204 zero body. For eligible logout, guarded invalidation of this exact server session/CSRF/token/channel/output authority precedes acknowledgement; expire exact __Host-hsd_staff cookie with Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/ no Domain and Max-Age=0. No Microsoft redirect or all-device logout claim.
routes.idempotent: Under valid source/control admission, absent staff cookie may return the same generic204 and clear only local cookie identity, revoking no server session. An authentic unexpired same-kind token resolving through a complete authoritative lookup to a known terminal or absent session may also receive harmless204/clear. An eligible different/current successor session with missing/stale CSRF or retired token is403 with no Set-Cookie/revocation. Malformed, wrong-kind, invalid-signature or expired JWT is403 rather than an authorizing decode-only logout path. Required store/key/clock uncertainty is503, never false acknowledged server invalidation. Repeated success is harmless, not a guarantee every malformed/expired request has the same status.
routes.meaning: No POST body may choose a session or principal. Known terminal/missing no-op cannot change another session. Client clears private UI on deliberate logout and treats503/transport loss as logout pending until authoritative reconciliation; browser cookie clearing cannot prove server revocation. Late cookie clobbering can require reauthentication but cannot reactivate a revoked server session.

controlSource.header: Require exactly one X-HSD-Session-Control:1 on all four routes. It is a public protocol marker, not a secret or authority. Reject missing/duplicate/other values with fixed403, no CORS/redirect/HTML/JSONP. It prevents simple embedded/navigation calls from reading these API projections; all identity/output checks remain mandatory.
controlSource.reads: Same-origin HTTPS cookie fetch, credentials same-origin, cache no-store, redirect error, Accept application/json. A present Origin must exactly match configured trusted scheme/host/port; null/malformed/foreign denies. Otherwise a present Referer must parse to that origin. For these GETs only, absence of both retains current credential+custom-header+SOP/no-CORS guards, not identity evidence. Available Fetch Metadata must indicate same-origin; missing metadata removes no other guard. A hostile present source cannot fall back to absence.
controlSource.mutations: Preserve existing authenticated mutation rule: exact trusted Origin when present; only when absent may exact parsed Referer establish origin. Missing both, null/foreign/malformed source denies even with control header. Require one current bounded canonical X-HSD-CSRF for eligible renewal/logout. CSRF-free absent/known-terminal logout is a harmless no-op under valid origin/control/framing, never permission to act on an eligible session. No simple form/text types or pre-login OIDC/callback handling through this profile.
controlSource.cookies: Exactly one unquoted canonical staff JWT cookie value at most2048 ASCII bytes, no percent/whitespace/padding/ambiguous duplicate or alternate credential source. Aggregate Cookie/header bounds apply before lookup. No Authorization/Bearer fallback or JWT from JSON/query/path. Treat duplicate credentials as403 without choosing last. Do not echo credentials/source/headers in diagnostics.

claimsCandidate.body: Propose exactly iss aud sub sid jti iat nbf exp. iss fixed case-sensitive private string hengshi-design-staff-v1; aud fixed single string hengshi-design-staff-api-v1, not an array/wildcard. sub is private mapped Hengshi principal UUID; sid independently issued server session UUID; jti independently issued current token UUID. No tid/oid/email/name/roles/grants/CSRF/source purpose/provider tokens/content or generation needed in browser claims; current server records supply epochs/generations.
claimsCandidate.dates: iat and nbf are equal floor(token-issued trusted UTC Unix seconds). exp is floor(original session absolute-deadline UTC seconds), unchanged on renew/re-delivery. All are canonical unsigned integer JSON tokens0..253402300799; no float/exponent/coercion. Require nbf=iat and iat<=now<exp, valid fixed issuer/audience/current server principal/session/token association, and exact current trusted server time before session idle/absolute/renewal business boundaries. Rounding down exp cannot extend access; guard precise session/token issuance independently. If no positive representable lifetime remains, do not issue or recover a token.
claimsCandidate.header: Require explicit exact typ hsd-staff+jwt and one bounded trusted kid/alg association from approved server key inventory. No token-selected accepted algorithm or key URL, none/unsecured JWT, mixed symmetric/asymmetric family, jku/x5u/jwk/x5c extension, decode-only signature bypass or provider/visitor token confusion. A closed header schema/actual chosen algorithm/key inventory remains held with the complete compatible graph and key custody; claims shape alone cannot certify a JWT.
claimsCandidate.raw: Propose compact JWS at most2048 ASCII characters, three canonical unpadded base64url components, bounded strict UTF8 JSON header<=128 decoded bytes and claims<=768; duplicate names, BOM, invalid scalars, unknown claims/headers and numeric aliases rejected before lossy dictionaries. Full signature and trusted algorithm/key/source/profile checks use qualified library built-ins; raw canonical/closed/type/current-authority rules are extra boundaries, not a hand-built crypto verifier. Key family/signature decoded bound must be explicitly registered before adoption, not an arbitrary package default.
claimsCandidate.binding: Current server token record must match the exact issued minimal claims and approved signing association; jti possession alone is no grant. Logical token/session epochs remain server-owned and finite current/prior state. This fixes candidate JWT expiry at original absolute deadline but original session idle and mandatory renewal currentness remain stricter; no long-lived-refresh-cookie family is introduced. Trusted principal/session encodings for the operator cursor may reuse the current UUID references, not caller payload or browser claims before verified current mapping.

http.intake: Exact catalogue candidate paths with no aliases/query. Request target<=256bytes; decoded header aggregate<=16384bytes including aggregate Cookie<=8192; at most64 fields; header/framing receive<=5sec. GET has no body/type/encoding/Transfer-Encoding; optional Content-Length only unambiguous zero. POST has Content-Type application/json with no parameters or only one charset=utf-8; decoded identity JSON<=64bytes, nesting<=1 and exactly empty object; no content encoding/transfer encoding/trailers. Reject/close ambiguous framing at trusted ingress without collecting a body or second-parser interpretation.
http.output: Body-bearing200/fixed errors are application/json strictUTF8 noBOM identity/noContentEncoding and<=1024emittedbytes, full serialization before headers. 204 has zero body/noContentType/noContentLength. No-store and nosniff on all complete route-owned responses; no validators/304, redirects/CORS/HTML diagnostics. Only successful renewal/logout may Set-Cookie under the specific rules; GETs/errors never do. Bodyless method/media/size refusals have no schema instance; HEAD omits hypothetical GET Content-Length.
http.errors: Fixed closed code/recovery pairs only:400 invalid_request/correct_request;403 request_denied/check_access;409 session_changed/check_session for renewal prepared-output race;413 request_too_large/correct_request after safe framed POST intake;415 unsupported_media_type/correct_request;429 request_limited/wait;503 service_unavailable/check_session;500 internal_error/check_session. Only renewal uses409; bodyless405 Allow exact method and501/406/414/431 object-independent before private lookup; bodyless HEAD405 omits private hypothetical length. Effective Accept follows RFC media-range/quality rules; absent permitsJSON. Uniform403 carries no existence/source/proof/expiry/private reason. Actual ingress failures are observation failure, not auth/business outcome.

resources.pool: Propose one32-control shared service-wide pool across all four routes from receiving through crypto/current authority/output/draining; reserve before route-owned receive/auth work, no hidden queue. No independent pool per path. Controls do not borrow operator/business pools or relax their limits. At most one admitted control per eligible session after current control-authority verification; same permit continues through known settlement.
resources.rate: Propose10starts per rolling60sec per eligible issued session across all four paths/tabs/JWT rotations/workers;30 per verified eligible principal across its sessions;120 per trusted ingress-derived network bucket. Session/principal keyed state allocated only after current control eligibility, not unverified/retired/unknown selectors. A stale token outside permitted recovery cannot poison its successor's account/session budget. Network count covers all attempted control starts. These are unmeasured candidate budgets, not approved workload/capacity or a login-policy bypass.
resources.keys: At most1024live session keys,256principal keys and4096network keys, finite service-owned state. Network bucket formation uses only a reviewed canonical trusted-ingress client-network mapping under existing privacy class, never raw caller Forwarded/Host or identity inference. Exact address grouping/pseudonymization and counter physical memory/work mapping remain held. Capacity refuses new keys; never evict/reset active state or release uncertain reservations. Retire only after window/block and known work settlement.
resources.delay: To satisfy existing progressive-delay policy without a waiting queue, propose429 Retry-After10 then20 then30 seconds for repeated window excess on the relevant bounded bucket, capped30. Requests during its block do not push the block farther. Reset stage only after a full no-excess window and settled work; no permanent account/network lock. Limits remain per scope and must not make one network a perpetual lock on unrelated accounts. No server sleep or automatic client retry; deliberate later attempt after stated delay.
resources.deadlines: Propose admitted crypto/current lookup/mutation/serialization<=2sec after admitted headers; response delivery<=5sec; client observation<=10sec. Network/ASGI cancellation does not free shared or session reservations until known settlement. Unknown mutation/cookie delivery keeps safe auth uncertainty, no second successor or false logout. Output and cursor/source guards still apply within deadline.
resources.client: Bounded coordinator: initial status and current-CSRF retrieval once per eligible context; no polling except one scheduled visible status when server-provided renewal due is reached, then at most one renewal and one confirming status. Unknown renewal may use at most one same-context recovery request with retained CSRF, followed by one status check, then deliberate reauthentication. No catch-up storm/auto-429 retry/business resend. Losing auth/context clears transient secret/status/private UI under current purpose and drops old responses. A context_id/revision is only a UI correlation hint, never trusted authorization. Sleep, hidden/network restore or tab hints do not renew activity or bypass rate windows.

acceptance: Independent security/architecture/control review before canonical binding and closed representations. New routes and claims/control identifiers are candidate registrations for existing requirements, not adopted API. Exact header algorithm/key family, Entra tenant/freshness, trusted network mapping, clock/source purpose/copy and physical final writer/SQL/limiter mechanisms, whole-process UI/accessibility and integrated founder approval remain required. Future actual HTTP/cryptographic/state/store/race tests follow separately authorized implementation; schemas validate shape only.
